name: Where the Anemones Bloom
source:
Cordelia leads a life that most mermaids would envy. She has close friends and is part of a prominent pod, her future is all planned out. But Cordelia isn’t most mermaids. When her pod moves to the coast, she’s warned about the forbidden shallows and the dangers that lurk beyond. She’s heard all the rumours of course, but none of her friends will go near it. Curiosity gets the better of Cordelia, and she soon finds herself trembling at the fearful lights and hum of this strange city. However, something - someone actually - has also caught her eye. What starts as mere curiosity blossoms into something far more interesting. 

Soon Cordelia questions who she really is, and what she really wants. As she ventures further into uncharted territory, she gets closer to love but further from who she is and what she knows. Will she risk it all for a taste of the forbidden?

[From [url=https://katbfine.itch.io/mermaid-romance]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
科迪莉亚过着令大多数美人鱼羡慕的生活。她有亲密的朋友，并且是一个杰出群体的一员，她的未来都是计划好的。但科迪莉亚并不是大多数美人鱼。当她的吊舱移至海岸时，她收到关于禁止浅滩和潜伏在远处的危险的警告。她当然听过所有的谣言，但她的朋友都不会靠近。好奇心战胜了科迪莉亚，她很快发现自己在这座陌生城市的可怕灯光和嗡嗡声中颤抖。然而，有件事——实际上是某个人——也引起了她的注意。最初的好奇心逐渐发展成为更有趣的事情。

很快，科迪莉亚质疑她到底是谁，以及她真正想要什么。当她进一步冒险进入未知领域时，她离爱情越来越近，但离她是谁和她所知道的却越来越远。她会冒着一切危险去尝尝禁忌的滋味吗？

[来自[url=https://katbfine.itch.io/mermaid-romance]Itch.io[/url]]
